title: mentha suaveolens var. elongata
intro: Mentha suaveolens var. elongata, commonly known as a variant of the Sweet Marjoram plant, is a type of herb belonging to the mint family. It is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing stress and anxiety, improving sleep quality, and alleviating symptoms of digestive issues such as nausea and bloating. The therapeutic actions of Mentha suaveolens var. elongata include acting as a mild sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial agent, making it useful in traditional medicine for treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
